simulation_limit.rule: A candidate receives PASS or functional FAIL only when the RTL and ISA executions contain compared architectural values. A program that does not finish within the 2,000,000-cycle limit is FAIL. A host timeout is also an infrastructure failure.

directed_test_build.reproducibility_note: Invoke build_directed_test.sh from the repository root with a repository-relative test source path to reproduce the recorded ELF hashes. Invoking from an ancestor of the source directory other than the repository root can select a different source-directory prefix mapping.

problem_specific_additions.reason: The numerical counter reset value is unspecified. Initialize both halves of mcycle and minstret through CSR writes before the increment-read sequence.
Write and read the low and high halves of minstret.

problem_specific_additions.name: counter_external_ports
problem_specific_additions.requirements: Observe only counter_val_o and counter_val_upd_o after establishing both halves with individual writes. Check legal individual low/high writes, write priority over increment, increment, hold, carry and modulo-2^64 wrap. With ProvideValUpd=1 the output is the current value plus one even during hold or writes; with ProvideValUpd=0 it is zero.
problem_specific_additions.scope: Only selected 64-bit instances with ProvideValUpd=0/1. No narrow counter, FPGA DSP, X/Z, simultaneous half writes, or numerical reset-value obligation is added.
problem_specific_additions.parameter_evidence: SPEC.md presents CounterWidth=64 parent instances with ProvideValUpd=0/1 and the module declaration explicitly describes the incremented output and disabled zero.
problem_specific_additions.integration: Run after the five CPU programs. An output mismatch, a build failure and a run that does not complete are FAIL; a wall-clock interruption is INVALID.
